title: Caleb’s request at eighty-five
english: [[Caleb son of Jephunneh: I am eighty-five; give me the hill country of Hebron >> Bible:Joshua 14:6-12]]. Faith does not age. The Anakim — pride’s giants — must be driven out.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).
